nodes.title: Update exports and implement to_superpauli
nodes.description: Update the __all__ list to include 'to_superpauli' and 'superpauli_to_super'. Implement the public to_superpauli function that converts a superoperator from column-stacking basis to Pauli basis. This function should leverage the existing _to_superpauli internal function but provide proper public documentation with full docstring. The function should accept a Qobj representing a quantum map (superoperator, Choi matrix, or unitary operator) and return a Qobj representing the same map in the Pauli basis. It should validate that the input has qubit dimensions.
nodes.expected_output: Updated __all__ list containing 'to_superpauli' and 'superpauli_to_super', and a public function with signature to_superpauli(q_oper: Qobj) -> Qobj with comprehensive docstring documenting parameters, returns, raises, and examples.

nodes.title: Implement superpauli_to_super
nodes.description: Implement the public superpauli_to_super function that converts a superoperator from Pauli basis back to column-stacking (supermatrix) basis. This is the inverse transformation of to_superpauli. The function should validate that the input is a superoperator, check that dimensions are qubit-based (powers of 2), compute the number of qubits, construct the normalized superpauli basis B, and perform the inverse basis transformation B @ q_oper @ B.dag(). The function should handle dimension matching similar to _to_superpauli.
nodes.expected_output: Public function with signature superpauli_to_super(q_oper: Qobj) -> Qobj with comprehensive docstring documenting parameters, returns, raises, and notes about the inverse relationship to to_superpauli.

nodes.title: Final file assembly
nodes.description: Integrate all changes into the complete Python file. Place the new public functions after the existing conversion functions (to_super, to_choi, to_chi, etc.) to maintain logical organization. Ensure consistent code style with the existing file, proper indentation, and that all functions work together. The complete file should include the updated __all__ list and both new functions properly integrated into the module structure.
nodes.expected_output: The COMPLETE modified Python file with all changes applied. Not a fragment. Not just the new functions. The entire file from '# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-' to the last line, including the updated __all__ list and the new to_superpauli and superpauli_to_super functions properly positioned in the file.
